title: Who should take this further?
intro: One request to the right expert: Tax Advisory for paid, lawyer-reviewed work, or a public body whose services are free.

share.title: Summary Tiva will share
share.contact: Plus your name, company, email, phone (if given) and your note.
share.none: No project in context: only your contact details and your note will be shared.

fee.paid: Paid engagement · fee proposal before any work

consent: I agree to share this summary and my contact details with {{expert}}.
consentRequired: Please tick the box to agree before we share anything.
feeNote: You receive a written fee proposal before any work starts.

referral.text: Tiva may receive a referral fee from paid experts. Public bodies are always listed free and never pay for referrals.
referral.detail: Tiva is built by Law Technology Solutions with Tax Advisory as expert partner. When you choose a paid expert and go on to engage them, Tiva may receive a referral fee from that expert. It never changes the price you are quoted, and Tiva's answers stay the same whoever you choose. Nothing is shared without the consent you give on this page.

sent.title: Your request is with {{expert}}
sent.text: They have your contact details and your note.
sent.textProject: They have your project summary and roadmap, so you won't need to explain it again.

paid.step1: An adviser confirms the call by email, and by WhatsApp if you gave a number.
paid.step2: On the call you agree the scope of work.
paid.step3: You receive a written fee proposal before any work starts.

free.step1: The public body's investor desk confirms the call by email.
free.step2: On the call they explain the procedure and the documents for your case.
free.step3: Their services are free; any official filing fees are explained up front.

sent.feeNote: No work starts and nothing is charged until you accept a written fee proposal.
sent.freeNote: Public bodies are listed free of charge and never pay Tiva for referrals.
sent.fallback: If anything goes wrong, you can also copy the request or send it by email.
sent.missing: We could not find this request.
